scope: J06 followup source and test-assertion review only

evidence.observation: One RuleRng.shuffle before the ask stores a private candidate permutation after the paid card.
HiddenCard maps into the stored suffix and checks current target-hand membership.
Ask reconstruction checks stage, mode, non-self target, and complete candidate multiset without shuffling.
New test source asserts 8 seeded candidate orders, fixed archive mapping and RNG, and duplicate-map archive rejection.

retained_source_differences.difference: Phase-local mode and usable counters remain turn-stamped.
retained_source_differences.native: u01_batch_a_asks.rs:18; mode flags and used count

retained_source_differences.difference: Top mode is excluded before payment when no other he; source pays before checking gainable target list.
retained_source_differences.test_boundary: The new no-other-he test freezes native behavior and is not an upstream-equivalence negative case.

retained_source_differences.difference: All target hand/equipment are enumerated; source getGainableCards and shown/viewHandcard branches are not represented by qinglong_options.
Native waits for the gain answer before processing the emitted payment CardsLost child; source awaits player.lose before target/gain selection.
Full gain/give/move/reveal event semantics remain outside this patch.

not_covered: all private-candidate sizes and equipment combinations
